quickstats_kansas.csv.source: USDA NASS Quick Stats bulk crops file
quickstats_kansas.csv.provenance: Exact P20 gzip recovered from local cache; SHA-256 matched; P25 made no new bulk request.
quickstats_kansas.csv.filters: KS state ANSI 20; county survey; total domain; annual YEAR; 1990–2024; winter-wheat non-irrigated and all-practice yield in BU / ACRE. Preserved source values and identifying columns with NUL padding removed.

kansas_centroids.csv.source: U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb Kansas Counties, January 1, 2026
kansas_centroids.csv.coordinates: CENTLAT / CENTLON. FIPS and basename are from the same table. These are fixed geographic centroids.

power_manifest.json.source: NASA POWER daily climate point API, AG community, local solar time
power_manifest.json.archive: power_archive contains gzip-compressed original cache envelopes. The manifest records the parameters, timestamp, HTTP status and SHA-256 for each archive.
